description: Reported fundamentals for US-GAAP filers from SEC XBRL data: revenue, operating income, net income, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow, total assets/liabilities, equity, cash, margins and YoY revenue growth for the last 1-12 annual or quarterly periods. Q4 and quarterly cash flows are derived from year-to-date filings and flagged. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.005 USDC on Base)

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (alternative to ticker).

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B. Provide ticker or cik.
